added.body:
Hi all,

Here is a summary of the Leadership Sync notes from March 2026.

---
LEADERSHIP SYNC — MARCH 25, 2026
Attendees: Dana Kim, Marcus Webb, Priya Sharma
---

1. Q2 PLANNING
   - Approved $1.2M budget for Platform team expansion
   - 4 engineers + 1 PM starting April 15
   - Marcus to finalize headcount allocation by EOW

2. HIRING PIPELINE
   - 23 candidates currently in pipeline
   - 72% offer acceptance rate (up from 65% last quarter)
   - Targeting 40% diversity across new hires

3. BUDGET REVIEW
   - Q1 spend: $3.8M (under budget by $200K)
   - Carry-forward approved for Q2 infrastructure upgrades

ACTION ITEMS:
   - Dana: Finalize job descriptions by March 28
   - Marcus: Schedule architecture review with Platform team
   - Priya: Prepare diversity metrics report for April sync

---
Full notes are in the shared doc: Leadership Sync — March.

Best,
Alex
